newsitem.title: USA: Transit in talks to sell parcel service.
newsitem.headline: Transit in talks to sell parcel service.

text.p: Transit Group Inc said Monday it is negotiating to sell its parcel delivery service.
The sale would cut about $2.25 million in debt, Transit said, adding the service accounted for almost all of its $23.4 million in revenues and net loss of $5.1 million, or $1.48 a share, in 1996.
Transit added the sale would complete its transformastion into a holding company for truckload carriers.
The company also said Monday it completed the acquisition of private Carolina Pacific Distributors Inc for about $11.3 million in cash and stock.
Under the deal, which was first announced in May, Transit paid Carolina's owners $3.5 million in cash and 1.73 million shares of its common stock.
Transit's stock closed at 6-7/8 on Friday, near its 52-week high of 7-1/4.
